fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Open Lawn Area; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Street Frontage
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Rear Access; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Trim any shrubs or low-hanging branches along the front driveway to maintain clear vehicle passage.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicle access to the front of the structure.
• Install a reflective address marker at the street to help responders identify the property quickly from the road.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the structure to create a clear gap between plants and the building walls.
• Mark or clearly identify any rear access point so responders can locate it without searching the perimeter.
• Keep the rear access route clear of stored items, equipment, or debris that could slow responder movement.
• Maintain the walkway free of obstacles to allow rapid foot access between the street and the front entry.
• Keep any gates providing rear access unlocked or equipped with a lock box accessible to emergency services.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Irrigated Landscape; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim any shrubs that have grown close to the base of the house or attached structures.
• Keep low-hanging tree branches trimmed away from the roofline and gutters.
• Maintain open spacing between individual trees and shrubs across the property.
• Keep irrigated lawn and landscape areas watered to maintain green, low-growth conditions.
• Keep all driveways and access routes clear of overhanging branches to allow emergency vehicle passage.
